id: title:dmarticus:build project map from scoped teams for project scoped tokens

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop client OAuth authentication and project discovery, specifically supporting team-scoped identity and session state.
review.reason: The change adds support for team-scoped OAuth tokens and session state. P1.F3.H1 adds the `scoped_teams` field to the OAuth response schema, P1.F2.H1 adds `scopedTeamIds` to session storage, and P1.F2.H3 parses these values to route project discovery. This establishes a bounded capability for the desktop client to distinguish and access team-specific resources, rather than a global
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the OAuth provider implementation and backend support, which are not demonstrated in this frontend-only chunk. No production incident or adoption is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds scoped_teams to OAuth token response schema.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the desktop client to receive team-scoped token metadata from the OAuth provider.

observations.behavior: Adds scopedTeamIds to InMemorySession and StoredSessionInput.
observations.posthog_connection: Stores team-scoped project IDs in the session state for later use in project discovery.

observations.behavior: Parses scoped_teams from token response and routes to team-specific project fetching.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves team-scoped IDs through the authentication flow to support team-specific project discovery.
